## Summary
Anas Ali is a Full-Stack Software Engineer, Machine Learning Specialist, and Robotics Engineer based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. He is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering (2023 - 2027) at Government Engineering College, Jaipur.

His engineering expertise spans high-performance modern web architectures (React 18, Next.js 15, Node.js, Supabase), deep learning and artificial intelligence (PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Generative AI, LangChain, Gemini API), and embedded systems robotics (ESP32, Arduino C++, SolidWorks, Blynk IoT).

## Featured Engineering Projects
1. AI Finance Manager
   - Stack: Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Supabase, Inngest, Clerk, Prisma, Arcjet, Resend, Gemini API.
   - Architecture: Client (Next.js 15) -> Clerk Auth -> Inngest Background Workers -> Gemini Flash OCR Parser -> Supabase PostgreSQL via Prisma.
   - Key Features: Automated OCR receipt scanning, cron-scheduled recurring transactions, automated ledger categorization, and bot attack mitigation.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/AI-Finance-Manager

2. Model Wall-E Perception Car
   - Stack: ESP32 Microcontroller, Arduino C++, Blynk IoT, Ultrasonic Sensors, SolidWorks CAD, L298N Driver.
   - Architecture: Ultrasonic & IR Sensors -> ESP32 Microcontroller -> L298N Motor Driver -> Blynk IoT Real-Time Telemetry.
   - Key Features: Low-latency Wi-Fi telemetry (<20ms latency), obstacle perception math, autonomous collision avoidance, and 3D printed chassis.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/RCAT-Robotics-and-Automation

3. Crop Prediction System
   - Stack: Python, Scikit-Learn, Flask, NumPy, Pandas.
   - Architecture: Agricultural Parameters (NPK, Temperature, Humidity, Rainfall) -> Flask API Server -> Random Forest / XGBoost Classifier -> Crop Recommendation.
   - Key Features: Multi-regional soil dataset feature engineering, >95% prediction accuracy, lightweight REST API inference.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/Crop-Prediction-System

4. Developer Portfolio Web Engine
   - Stack: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Framer Motion, HTML5 Canvas 2D.
   - Architecture: Vite React 18 Engine -> 2D Canvas Physics Engine -> Dual-Track Gantt Trajectory -> Spotlight Command Palette -> Retro CLI Terminal Mode.
   - Key Features: 60 FPS spatial starfield, dual theme (Dark Space & Light Blueprint), zero layout shift, Schema.org JSON-LD graph.
   - Live URL: https://anas-ali-global.netlify.app/
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/Anas_Ali_Portfolio

5. Drive Clone Cloud Storage Platform
   - Stack: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Multer, JWT, REST APIs.
   - Architecture: Client Upload -> Express Middleware (Multer) -> MongoDB GridFS -> JWT Authentication.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/Drive_Clone

6. Password Manager
   - Stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Web Crypto API.
   - Architecture: Client Secret -> Web Crypto API AES/PBKDF2 Encryption -> Local Encrypted Vault.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/Password-Manager

7. Automobile Garage Management System
   - Stack: PHP, MySQL, Apache, XAMPP, Bootstrap.
   - Architecture: Client Form -> Apache Server -> PHP Controller -> MySQL Relational Database.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/Automobile-Garage-Management-System

8. Real-Time Token & Order System
   - Stack: Node.js, Express, React, SQLite, Socket.IO.
   - Architecture: Order Terminal -> Express Server -> Socket.IO WebSocket Server -> Display Screen.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/Token_System
